title: Tournament data in backups; unattended CourtHive upgrades
description: Extend backup and restore (WI-138) to include the tournament database when the profile is on, so one archive restores the whole club. Make CourtHive upgrades unattended: the calendar refactor in the server's 7.x line needed a backfill script run by hand between two migrations or the server crashed on start. Wrap such steps so that moving from one bundled version to the next is 'pull, restart' - with a pre-upgrade backup, ordered migration and backfill steps, and a clear stop-and-report if one fails. Record which bundled app versions pair with which CourtHive versions.

recommended_model.name: Opus 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Data-safety work across two databases with ordering constraints learned the hard way.

acceptance_criteria: `backup` with tournaments on includes a consistent dump of the tournament database; `restore` brings back both systems
Round-trip test: create a tournament with a draw, back up, wipe, restore, and the draw is intact
Upgrading between two bundled versions that include a data backfill needs no manual command
A failed upgrade step leaves the previous version runnable and says what to do
A compatibility table of app and CourtHive versions is published with each release

notes: Existing tournaments with draws must never be modified by tooling without a backup first.
The known manual sequence is in docs/PRODUCTION_QUICK_REFERENCE.md section 4 (backfill-calendar-tournaments between migrations 047 and 048).
See docs/courthive_bundle_design.md (WI-142, 2026-11-22): the app image gains the Postgres client tools; dump and restore run over the internal network with the generated database password.

See docs/courthive_bundle_design.md (WI-142, 2026-11-22): a fresh install on the bundled version needs no backfill (all migrations run on an empty database); the ordered-steps entrypoint in the server image is for later versions. Rehearse it by replaying the known 047/048 backfill on a copy of older data.
See docs/courthive_bundle_design.md (WI-142, 2026-11-22): the compatibility table of app and CourtHive image tags lives in the changelog; the compose file of each release pins exact tags.

testing_requirements: Backup and restore round trip with tournament data
Upgrade rehearsal across a backfill boundary using a copy of real data

context.user_story: As a club, I want my championship draws to be as safe as my league data.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
